description: Blinded Ed25519 inputs every implementation must reject, by operation. blind_public_key blinds public_key_hex by blind_factor_hex; a BACAP implementation must also refuse a ReadCap whose root public key is public_key_hex. blind blinds private_key_hex (64 bytes, seed || public key) and public_key_hex by an empty factor. verify checks signature_hex over message_hex under public_key_hex as a BACAP box ID; verification is cofactorless and refuses a small-order key or R. category names the failure: invalid_key, empty_factor, small_order_key, small_order_r, signature_invalid.

vectors.name: blind_torsioned_root_key
vectors.description: an honest public key plus a point of order 8: on the curve but outside the prime-order subgroup

vectors.name: blind_identity_root_key
vectors.description: the identity point as a root public key

vectors.name: blind_empty_factor
vectors.description: an honest key blinded by a factor of 0 bytes, refused for both the private and the public key

vectors.name: verify_identity_key
vectors.description: the identity as the box ID with R the identity and s = 0, which verifies any message without the small-order check on the key

vectors.name: verify_identity_r
vectors.description: an honest key with R the identity and s = H(R || A || M)*a, which a cofactorless verifier accepts without the small-order check on R

vectors.name: verify_torsioned_r
vectors.description: an honest key with R = r*B plus a point of order 8 and s = r + H(R || A || M)*a, which only a cofactored verifier accepts
